description: Dummy case studies showing how projects go from brief to launch. Replace with your real work anytime from the CMS.

items.title: Local Business WordPress Site
items.excerpt: Redesigned a slow brochure site into a fast, mobile-first WordPress build with clear CTAs.
items.problem: The old site was outdated, slow on mobile, and not converting visitors into calls.
items.solution: Rebuilt on WordPress + Elementor with a focused landing structure, compressed media, and clear contact paths.
process: Design in Figma, then Elementor build
results: Clear primary CTA on every key page
Faster perceived load with optimized images

items.title: GoHighLevel Funnel Landing
items.excerpt: Designed a high-converting GHL landing page with form, trust blocks, and mobile-first sections.
items.problem: Paid traffic was landing on a generic page with weak messaging and no social proof.
items.solution: Built a structured funnel page: hero, benefits, proof, FAQ, and sticky mobile CTA.
process: Iterate after first week of data

items.title: Personal Portfolio Rebuild
items.excerpt: Rebuilt this portfolio in React + Tailwind with CMS-driven content and polished motion.
items.problem: Needed a fast, maintainable portfolio that non-devs can update via CMS.
items.solution: Content JSON + admin CMS, modular sections, and performance-minded UI.
results: Ready for case studies and blog
